text: The 369 is a digital motor protection system designed to protect and manage medium sized AC motors and their driven equipment. It contains a full range of selectively enabled, self contained protection and control elements as detailed in the Functional Block Diagram and Features table.

heading: Key Features

text: Three independent rear RS485 ports offer the customer flexibility and performance for their communication network. The 369 can
heading: Key Features

text: communicate at baud rates up to 19,200 bps using the industry standard Modbus® RTU protocol. Fiber optic (option F) Profibus interface (option P), DeviceNet (option D), and Ethernet (option E) ports are also available. The optional direct connect RJ45 Ethernet port can be used to connect the 369 to 10 Mbps Ethernet networks. The communication system of the 369 is designed to allow simultaneous communication via all ports.
heading: Key Features

text: The EnerVista™ Suite is an industry leading set of software programs that will simplify every aspect of using the 369 relay. Tools to monitor the status of the motor, maintain the relay, and integrate information measured by the 369 into HMI or SCADA monitoring systems are available. Also provided are the utilities to analyze the cause of faults and system disturbances using the powerful waveform and Sequence of Event viewers that come with the EnerVista™ 369 Setup Software that is included with each relay.
